user.title: Choose the ecosystem
user.description: Pick the app your devices are paired with. The cloud is used only to obtain local keys; control is local.

login.title: Sign in to {provider}
login.description: Smart Life / Tuya Smart: enter the user code shown in the app under Me → Settings → Account and Security. Ledvance SMART+ / Sylvania: use the e-mail and password of the app account. Tuya IoT Platform: paste the cloud project access id/secret.

data.api_device_id: Any device id of the account (optional)
data.name: Device name

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.description: Open the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app, tap “+” → “Scan”, scan this code and confirm. Then press Submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {provider}
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud session expired. Sign in again to refresh the local keys.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the credentials and the region.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the cloud. Try again later.
error.not_scanned: The QR code has not been scanned (or confirmed) yet.

data.cloud_refresh_hours: Cloud refresh interval (0 = only when a key fails)
data.cloud_fallback: Send commands through the cloud when the device is unreachable on the LAN

set_dps.name: Set data points
set_dps.description: Write raw DP values to a device over the LAN (cloud fallback when enabled).

dps.name: Data points
dps.description: Mapping of DP id to value, for example dp 1 to true.

refresh_cloud.name: Refresh from cloud
refresh_cloud.description: Re-fetch devices, local keys and DP schemas from the provider now.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Limit the refresh to one account (all when omitted).

reconnect.name: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Drop the LAN connection of a device and reconnect immediately.
